title: Inverse Optimization Without Inverse Optimization: Direct Solution Prediction with Transformer Models
summary: We present an end-to-end framework for generating solutions to combinatorial optimization problems with unknown components using transformer-based sequence-to-sequence neural networks. Our framework learns directly from past solutions and incorporates the known components, such as hard constraints, via a constraint reasoning module, yielding a constrained learning scheme. The trained model generates new solutions that are structurally similar to past solutions and are guaranteed to respect the known constraints.
